description: Weights and thresholds for the collapse equation S(a|f,C) = Σ wₖ·eₖ − Σ vⱼ·gⱼ, then collapse if S(a*) ≥ θ and S(a*)−S(a₂) ≥ δ, else park. Identifier dominates (reproduces the proven entity collapse); register/domain/collocation drive sense disambiguation; frequency is the dominant-sense prior (1/sense_rank from WordNet's frequency ordering) — the most-frequent-sense default ABSENT other evidence; pin is the domain-conditional override a domain/curated pack asserts (weight above all soft evidence, below only id, so a curated sense beats the frequency default); prior is the cyclical feedback term (accumulated collapse_decisions); contributor_trust down-weights evidence from low-trust open contributors (anonymous / repeatedly-flagged), neutral 0.5 when unknown.
